description: ACL inventory of the Phase 2 build-out (spec §D.7, CC-1, CC-26; proposed D-135): every function the build-out migrations (supabase/migrations/20261123*.sql and 20261124*.sql: the Phase 2 files, the Phase 3 platform-prep files and the folded Phase 3 wave 1 stream files of blocks 04 and 06) create or redefine in public, by identity (name and argument types), with exactly the roles that may EXECUTE it ([] = nobody: trigger functions), from the grant columns of spec §A; and every table and view they create with the privileges authenticated holds (table level, plus column-level grants). anon holds nothing on any of them and no function is executable by PUBLIC or anon. Asserted after build-out pass 2 by supabase/tests/sql/zz_platform/acl.test.sql, which also fails when a build-out function or relation is missing here. Hand-maintained: a new function or grant changes this file in the same commit, reviewed against the spec. While two streams build at once, each keeps its entries in supabase/tests/fixtures/function-grants.d/<stream>.json (merged by scripts/db/lib/fragments.mjs) and the integrator folds them in here at the wave merge.
